dedupe_keys.name: indoor radio i q measurements under controlled jamming conditions

description: This deposit contains received in-phase and quadrature radio samples from controlled indoor interference experiments by Hamad Bin Khalifa University and Eindhoven University of Technology researchers. Seven Ettus USRP X310 radios provide a fixed transmitter and receiver with five alternative jammer devices. Experiments vary separation, power and interference type, including silent, tone and Gaussian-noise conditions, while transmitting a predetermined BPSK bit sequence over a non-line-of-sight office link. Zenodo lists thirty-one MATLAB files and an Excel README free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is one laboratory arrangement; exact acquisition dates and a common sampling rate were not established from the inspected metadata. Fixed hardware and controlled interference limit transfer to operational networks. A reviewer-assessed use is calibrating physical-layer impairment assumptions in wireless resilience simulations. platform-ns-3 is a related network simulator, without a verified raw-I/Q adapter. No signal data were downloaded, and no transmitter or interference generator was operated.
name: Indoor radio I/Q measurements under controlled jamming conditions
